answer: A new identity locks an 80-credit bond and needs five distinct saffron endorsers. In one round, each endorser sends a saffron-sealed whisper carrying its plume; the auditor checks plume, signatures and times, slashing the bond for a missing, replayed or late whisper. Each endorser vouches for at most two per round; the fee starts at 20 per endorser and rises 4 per later identity: the 1000th fake pays 4016 each, 20080; 1000 fakes pay 10090000, 80000 locked. A rented-endorser ring fails, since a third endorsement forfeits its stake. Honest agents pay 100 once.
